scope: offline synthetic databases; counts and native plans

queries.sql:
WITH ranks AS (
 SELECT MAX(json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId')) AS id,MAX(hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(data,'$.receivedAt'))) AS rank,MAX(hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(data,'$.receivedAt')) IS NULL) AS invalidTime FROM messages WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.sharedActivityId'),'')='' AND COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId'),'')!='' AND (json_extract(data,'$.direction')='outgoing' OR COALESCE(json_type(data,'$.seenTurnId'),'missing')!='null') GROUP BY json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId')
 
 ),combined AS (SELECT id,MAX(rank) AS rank,MAX(invalidTime) AS invalidTime FROM ranks GROUP BY id),
 joined AS (SELECT c.id,c.rank,hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(e.data,'$.openedAt')) AS openedEpoch,c.invalidTime OR hdsi_epoch_ms(json_extract(e.data,'$.openedAt')) IS NULL AS invalidTime FROM combined c JOIN chat_episodes e ON e.id=c.id),
 ranked AS (SELECT *,MAX(invalidTime) OVER () AS anyInvalidTime,RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rank DESC,openedEpoch DESC) AS boundary FROM joined)
 SELECT id,rank,openedEpoch,anyInvalidTime AS invalidTime FROM ranked WHERE boundary<=?
SELECT data FROM chat_episodes WHERE id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) ORDER BY rowid

SELECT rowid,data FROM messages WHERE json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId') IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.sharedActivityId'),'')='' AND COALESCE(json_extract(data,'$.chatEpisodeId'),'')!='' AND (json_extract(data,'$.direction')='outgoing' OR COALESCE(json_type(data,'$.seenTurnId'),'missing')!='null') ORDER BY rowid
